name: Liechtenstein

observations.reasoning: Sourced on 2026-07-27, transversal pass over the population indicator. Population on 1 January 2025: 40886 inhabitants, recorded as 0.041 million. Eurostat dataset demo_pjan, Population on 1 January by age and sex, read through the dissemination API on 2026-07-27, dataset last updated 2026-07-09. Total population, both sexes, all ages, which is exactly what this indicator's denominator asks for. Read as one table covering every country in the record, so no value here is derived from a neighbour: each is that country's own row. The previous value was an opening estimate produced with no source and no research.

Searched on 2026-07-27, in German, as part of the transversal venues pass over the smallest countries. Zero, and for once a zero that can be argued rather than assumed, because the country's whole professional theatre infrastructure is one house. The TAK in Schaan, read on its own page, states that it fulfils the role of a state theatre for Liechtenstein, that it has been organised under private law as a cooperative since 1972, and that since 2019/20 it holds an ensemble of its own — a drama ensemble. No puppetry or figure theatre unit appears anywhere on that page. Puppetry reaches Liechtenstein as guest programming, the visiting companies being Swiss and Austrian, which is a fact about touring and not about a Liechtenstein venue. The denominator asks for a permanent puppetry unit with a venue of its own and public backing; there is no puppetry unit at all, so the two other conditions never arise. The previous value was the same zero, produced with no research: the number does not move, the standing behind it does.

Web check of 2026-07-27. No establishment retained. Liechtenstein has a single higher education institution, the University of Liechtenstein, whose provision covers architecture, planning, business and finance, with no drama department or higher arts school. In the absence of any higher arts education in the country, no specialised higher training in puppetry arts can exist. Upper bound held at 0 for that reason. Estimate: the argument rests on the size of the higher education system, not on a source read.

DISPUTED. First value produced as a mean conditioned on artists who actually tour, which drops from the denominator the makers who do not perform. Method error identified: a fee is not a performance. For France the true median probably sits between 10 and 20, over a bimodal distribution. For countries with permanent companies, recomputed from the top: 250 to 400 performances a year, casts of 3 to 5, a company of about twenty, so on the order of 50 to 90. To be redone in full once the denominator is settled.
